claim: Web Summit runs from 9 to 12 November at the MEO Arena and FIL.
Oriente metro station is about 300 metres from the MEO Arena.
Oriente metro station is about 600 metres from Pavilhão de Portugal.
Carris runs a "Shuttle Web Summit" bus between Praça do Comércio and Oriente from Monday 9 to Thursday 12 November.
The Lisbon transport pass costs 23 euros for 3 days and 31.50 euros for 5 days.
Replacing a lost lanyard or wristband costs 100 euros.
Wristband and lanyard collection at Terminal 1 of Lisbon's Humberto Delgado Airport runs on 7 November from 9.30am to 10pm.
Wristband and lanyard collection at Pavilhão de Portugal runs on 7 and 8 November from 12pm to 6pm.
The Web Summit first-timers' meetup is on Tuesday 10 November from 11am to 11.55am.
The transport pass is not sold online and no one-day pass is offered this year, according to Executive Digest.
